name: voice-clone-setup
description: A clone of a person's own voice, saved for later speech. When the brief lacks them, one message asks for a clean 1 to 2 minute solo recording and the language, and names who processes it; the sample is cut once with ffmpeg; fal MiniMax voice-clone makes a stored voice by default (Qwen reference clone or one-off Chatterbox clip on request); the person judges an audition on their own name, a number and a sentence; the voice is reused, re-made from the kept sample when its id lapses, replaced or deleted on request. Consent is the app's; a named real person the brief did not supply is not imitated. Use when: clone my voice, use or save my voice, speak this in my cloned voice, audition or re-record my voice, my clone stopped working, delete my voice. NOT for: stock or timed voiceover, voice swap (media-audio-generation); dubbing (voice-dub); an avatar or presenter (voice-avatar-identity, voice-presenter-video); new lines or lip-sync in footage (voice-line-replace); writing the script (media-script-writer).
